newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian MinFins ease in quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: Russian MinFins ease in quiet trade.

text.p: Prices of Russian MinFin bonds eased on Monday and dealers said trading was quiet as the market saw no market-moving news.
"Everything is quiet today because it is Monday and there is no news that could push the market up or down," Inkombank dealer Alexander Nikolayev said.
Dealers said prices of the fourth, fifth and to a much lesser extent third tranche had eased earlier some 0.25 on client offers but recovered to morning levels.
"Trading is thin today and it looked as if a customer's order had pushed the market down as the market has come back to the opening levels," a London bank dealer said.
